reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanisms of composition-dependent solid-solution strengthening and temperature-induced dislocation mobility are generally coherent with known principles of HEA metallurgy, though they remain partly unverified by direct quantification of the structural interpretations.
reasons.testability: They define specific computational tests (MD simulations) with clear conditions and comparison to a baseline, offering direct measurements (UTS, modulus, elongation) whose mismatch with predictions would refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a systematic way to explore the role of composition and temperature on mechanical properties, offering guidelines for alloy tailoring and clear directions for both computational and experimental validation.
